Tarun Tewatia vs State Of Haryana on 16 April, 2024
 2024:P
 Crm-M-64135-2023
 
 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At
Chandigarh

(206) Crm-M-64135-2023
 Date of Decision:-16.0
Tarun Tewatia

......
 Versus
 State of Haryana

......Res
 Coram:
Hon'Ble
Mr. Justice Alok Jain

****
 Present: Mr. Jaswinder Singh, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Anmol Malik, DAG, Haryana  assisted by ASI Krishan Kumar.
Mr. Rahul Vats, Advocate for the complainant.

** * *
 ALOK JAIN, J. (Oral)

1. Prayer is for grant of anticipatory bail in case FIR No.137 dated 20.07.2023, under Sections 388,
420, 120-B and 34 of IPC, registered at Police Station Bahin, District Palwal.

2. Vide order dated 09.02.2024 while granting the concession of interim anticipatory bail, the parties had been relegated to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court and the parties have amicably resolved the dispute.
3. Learned counsel for the complainant has very fairly submitted that the payments have been made.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation 5.

Learned State counsel, on instructions from ASI Krishan Kumar submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation and his 2024:PHHC:051271 CRM-M-64135-2023 custodial interrogation is no longer required.
6. In view of above, the petition is allowed.
The order dated 09.02.2024 granting interim anticipatory bail to the petitioner, is made absolute.

However, the petitioner shall join the investigation as and when called upon to do so by the Investigating Agency and shall abide by the Tarun Tewatia vs State Of Haryana on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44321130/
1 conditions of Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
7.
